notes.title: Bug fixes and optimizations
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

A new update has just been released! It fixes several annoying bugs and improves overall performance across the Kingdom, especially loading times.

The Main Menu and the World of Zarabon now load in just a few seconds.

Bugs Fixed:
- Fixed the bug where the horse would detach from the cart
- Fixed the issue where villagers floated in the air upon spawning
- Enemies are no longer launched into the air when hit by the player

Optimizations:
- Improved code for better performance
- Reduced loading times for the Main Menu and the World of Zarabon

Next Step:
I’m currently working on controller support for the game.

In the meantime, feel free to report any bugs you encounter.
Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

Blackmyers

notes.title: Hero Creator is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Good news: the "Hero Creator" update is finally here… Prepare to dive into a richer, more epic adventure… full of secrets.

After two years of development, this major update is now accessible in the main branch. This update has been a huge technical and creative challenge. I have added many new contents and reworked all the code to improve performance and ensure an optimal gaming experience.

I would like to thank my wife and Cdrix for their help with the texts, as well as our community on Discord and Steam for their support with the experimental version.

The game is now available in ten languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Arabic, Japanese, Russian, Chinese, German, and Hindi.

Note: some translations have been fully completed using automated translation tools (translations in English and French are not affected). Some texts may require adjustments… or perhaps a mischievous goblin has hidden a few traps to slow down your progress! Thank you for your understanding.

[i][b]*** Important: It is essential to start a new game with this update. The old version of the game is not compatible. ***[/b][/i]

Discover everything that this major update brings:

[h2][b]Create Your Own Heroes[/b][/h2]
Create multiple heroes to conquer the mysterious lands of Zarabon. Play with them, level them up, make them stronger, then assign them to manage and protect your villages. They will rebuild destroyed buildings and organize villagers' work to ensure production. Who will become your champion?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/cddd1243d4d28032d7936c97e5b60082fee8fc3f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Different Types of Villagers[/b][/h2]
I’ve created a villager generation system that assigns them varied appearances and skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/94337dec858ad5743290a38ca57e544e8482b7fb.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dynamic Quest Generator[/b][/h2]
A dynamic quest generator has been set up to offer missions based on the villagers’ needs. Look for workers marked with an exclamation point: they need you… and maybe much more than it seems! Numerous quests will allow you to help the villagers and their communities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/b5e6e5fb753ea2e3fc9762b23195d99d9c8098ba.png[/img]

[h2][b]Armor Pieces[/b][/h2]
Your heroes and soldiers can now equip armor forged for the upcoming battles: helmets, chestplates, pants, gloves, and boots. You can also assign them an amulet and a ring to enhance their abilities. Will you have the courage to get them the most powerful equipment, even in the heart of danger?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/cb30588d9ae169c12fbf91018579395078f902d8.png[/img]

[h2][b]Training Camp at the Barrack[/b][/h2]
Set up targets to train your archers or training dummies for your soldiers. This will allow your troops—and you—to gain experience, become stronger, and... forge their legend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/58a644a54da9ef7bec71887cd6d55f8c925eda5c.png[/img]

[h2][b]Forge[/b][/h2]
Use the forge to melt metals and create ingots. These resources will help you craft better equipment, worthy of Zarabon’s ancient heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/875c0c179913ec2d7b005988857600eddc225126.png[/img]

[h2][b]Improvement of the Mining Career[/b][/h2]
Install a large furnace to melt your metals and produce ingots in larger quantities. Will you discover forgotten veins, buried for centuries?

[h2][b]Visit the General Store[/b][/h2]
Access the general store to buy or sell your goods at the counter, thanks to a new, more intuitive interface. Stock on the shelves varies depending on the available items. Keep an eye out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/e12bb3926a8f785d57e42c2d6051611862764302.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Caves to Explore[/b][/h2]
Go explore 19 different caves to extract precious resources: coal, iron, gold, silver, and diamonds. Some caves are linked to a village, allowing your miners to exploit them once the hostile creatures are cleared out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/74ac8aa9a21cdae5210428dbc6f62ad9f7cf7536.png[/img]

[h2][b]Elemental[/b][/h2]
Elementals, ancient guardians of the depths of the caves, fiercely protect the diamonds. Powerful and formidable, they offer a great reward to those who dare face them… and survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/5d0bd9c66f7eb1396f0d9f8304ff7c330385f757.png[/img]

[h2][b]Cave Troll[/b][/h2]
Deep within the large caves live the cave trolls. Fierce, they can be fought… but also tamed and domesticated. Who will dare to win their respect?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/829f32c31556095c36c9050d0158fd39cb7588f0.png[/img]

[h2][b]Skeleton[/b][/h2]
Face different types of skeletons in the caves and collect their equipment. Each battle awakens the remnants of a forgotten past!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/6b7a7b5e008e4356c0ea3d2cd0d8422f9b6676af.png[/img]

[h2][b]Mammoth[/b][/h2]
Mammoths live in the snowy mountains. You can fight them, but also tame them. Precious allies for attacking enemy villages… but at what cost?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/9367a2a1bc6a3dc88e2e48acd26352397fbca5de.png[/img]

[h2][b]Locked Access[/b][/h2]
Some accesses are locked by doors with a unique key. Without this key, no economic exchange will be possible between the villages of the snowy and forest biomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/2b9b07d56bae7c9a33e59fb8b2f504ac01012dee.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Weapons, Shields, and Tools[/b][/h2]
Discover new equipment, available by facing different creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/d3293af824b3bef1569df8615dac4289bfa9fa73.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Construction Elements[/b][/h2]
Additions: a Level 2 Workbench, a Wooden Hut, a Large Chest, a Light Post with Lantern, a Rabbit and Buckdjeuves Shelter, a Mannequin, and a Training Target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/7ae58c68cbc38bcdf914bfa4ac65973756b51e4a.png[/img]

[h2][b]World Map Expansion[/b][/h2]
The forest biome has been expanded, and a new snowy mountain biome has been added, including 18 buildable terrains, 9 goblin villages, and 6 yeti villages. And according to some rumors, secrets buried for centuries await discovery in these remote lands…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/464f56465f7495c41d5b7d61bd2ba3382d4b3068.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rabbits and Buckdjeuves[/b][/h2]
The forests welcome rabbits and buckdjeuves. Rabbits are peaceful, but beware of the buckdjeuves: they can become aggressive and attack at any moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/64b49aec3c7c9fe1700533e78f9b3bb717876ae1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rabbit Traps[/b][/h2]
Make traps to capture wild rabbits. Once captured, place them in a rabbit shelter and feed them to evolve into buckdjeuves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/d1bf114bdfa2eed6dd959537ba12fa3ad1ce6c32.png[/img]

Once the rabbit evolves, you’ll be able to ride the buckdjeuve or assign it to one of your soldiers to explore the world of Zarabon at full speed and safely.

[h2][b]Caribou and Saber-toothed Tigers[/b][/h2]
The Caribou and Saber-toothed Tigers roam the forests of the snowy mountains. Highly aggressive, they can be captured with traps. You’ll need to fill feeders to attract and tame them. But beware, some say they sense the souls of hunters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/22dca01a70920e407065f6d430e00d6f7a297e41.png[/img]

[h2][b]Cooking Recipes[/b][/h2]
Find recipes to give to your bakers so they can prepare new dishes, inspired by Zarabon’s forgotten traditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/834197ee453b3a759d06b79027797e1e4b91263c.png[/img]

[h2][b]Equipment Recipes[/b][/h2]
Find recipes to learn how to craft new equipment, or give them to your blacksmiths to craft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/5108aa1c63224fc5c2dbc66d66cccd6db7243f27.png[/img]

[h2][b]Character Comfort System[/b][/h2]
Your character's body temperature varies depending on the climate. Be careful: if they get too cold or too hot, they will lose health over time. Nature is also... your greatest adversary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/0f9c550cca28b0f5b6bb3e879de95291e8b90236.png[/img]

[h2][b]Store Manager[/b][/h2]
Hire a manager in your general store: they will sell surplus goods and buy requested resources from neighboring villages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/f10ba541d341813ba439bb09cad8b2170a19f347.png[/img]

[h2][b]Yeti Village[/b][/h2]
The yetis develop their own village in the snowy mountains. They are neutral, but you can strengthen your relationship by completing quests for them. Will you uncover the mysteries of their tribe?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/98ad049cb4ff8bfce1254306cd276b1debf5bab8.png[/img]

[h2][b]Yeti Horn[/b][/h2]
Use the Yeti Horn in one of your villages in the snowy mountains to send a distress signal. The Yeti chief will then send reinforcements to defend your village for a limited time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/c433e05ffb298be52557042a6819efa16bcd2e3f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Jacob Bright and the Werewolves[/b][/h2]
A mysterious man, dressed in wolf skin, roams the forests. Complete tasks for him and increase your reputation with the werewolves. Beware: during the full moon, he transforms into a werewolf and becomes extremely dangerous if you’re not allied. However, if you are allied, you can set up camp on their territory and receive protection against enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/74957b3f8abdb8017c6c1062f1b868c8c2791468.png[/img]

[h2][b]Village Road System[/b][/h2]
Build roads to improve circulation in your village. You can even name each road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/5ca0c83248f2030197f5d8760b3e5779d42962a5.png[/img]

Many other additions await you: go explore and dominate the world of Zarabon with this update full of content and features!

Meanwhile, I continue the development of the Multiplayer Mode (an experimental version will be available soon). "Where many walk, the path divides," they used to say. Allies... or enemies? The choice will be yours... with your friends!

New places will rise on the horizon, carrying forgotten secrets… Soon, the Tavern, the Fishing Hut, the Workshop, and even a Castle will enrich your lands and open new paths for your adventures.

A Wiki will also soon be available on my official site: www.blackmyers.com. You will find all the essential information to better understand the universe, refine your strategies, and progress faster.

With all these new features and improvements, it’s time to dive into the world of Zarabon and discover the many possibilities that await you. We can’t wait to see your creations, hear your feedback, and shape the future of the game together.

Join our community on Discord and the official Steam forum to interact with other adventurers, share your experiences, and stay informed of future updates.

The journey has only just begun, and we are counting on you to shape the story of this world.

Thank you so much for your support, adventurers, as your legend is only just beginning!

Blackmyers
Visit our website:
www.blackmyers.com

notes.title: Hero Creator Experimental Update 1.32 Final Part
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is the final part of the experimental version of the 1.32 update.

[h3][b]Detail to access the Hero Creator Experimental update[/b][/h3]
Visit our website for details on how to download this update: [url=https://www.blackmyers.com/ExperimentalUpdate1.32][b]Website[/b][/url]

[h3][b]The game is now available in several languages[/b][/h3]
The game is now translated into Spanish, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), German and Russian.

Other languages ​​will be translated soon. Let us know which languages you would like to see.

We used Google Translate to do the translation. There may be some errors in the translation.

[h2][b]Here are the updates in this version:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Rabbit Traps[/b][/h3]
You can now create and set rabbit traps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/96cfdc818f38547e80e04187975ee1487242ad0a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Rabbit Shelter[/b][/h3]
You can place captured rabbits in a shelter. After a while, they will evolve into Buckdjeuves. Once evolved, you can ride the Buckdjeuve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/dd575500b976081552b034a5e0aaaf5e96e74ff2.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Caribou Traps[/b][/h3]
You can now create and set caribou traps to capture and tame them. Once tamed, you can ride the caribou.

[h3][b]Sabertooth Traps[/b][/h3]
You can now create traps to capture and tame sabertooths. Once tamed, you can ride the sabertooth.

[h3][b]Dominating the Cave Troll and the Mammoth[/b][/h3]
When you engage in combat with the cave troll, a domination bar appears, showing the timer running out. If you manage to defeat the troll before the time expires, it will fall to its knees and you will have a chance to tame it. Once tamed, you can ride it and wreak havoc on enemies and their villages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/86fdde6c742daf4be2d14405791cec69f2b25d57.png[/img]

[h3][b]Store Manager[/b][/h3]
When you hire a store manager, they will be responsible for clearing surplus goods from the general store and purchasing requested goods from the neighboring village.

[h3][b]Village Manager[/b][/h3]
We can now hire one of your heroes to manage and protect your villages. They will manage the workers' jobs and rebuild destroyed buildings. However, you will need to pay them for their services.

[h3][b]Yeti Village[/b][/h3]
There are now Yeti villages in the Snowy Mountains biome. They are neutral by nature, but you can develop relationships with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/53a030d27a2cb6c1b3dde0895d8dddfaee17cd27.png[/img]

[h3][b]Yeti Horn[/b][/h3]
When used in one of your Snowy Mountain villages, the Yeti Horn sends a distress signal to the neighboring village, and the Yeti leader will send reinforcements to protect your village from enemies for a while.

[h3][b]Jacob Bright[/b][/h3]
A tall, strange man wearing a wolf pelt wanders the forests. You can complete tasks for him, which will increase your reputation with the werewolves. However, be careful: once he transforms into a werewolf, he becomes very dangerous if you are not allied with them.

[h3][b]Dynamic Quest Generator[/b][/h3]
I've created a dynamic quest generator system that generates quests based on the person's requests. The workers with an exclamation mark will have tasks for you. I've created many different quests to help the workers and their villages.

Heroes will request more difficult quests, but the rewards will be greater.

[h3][b]Large Lantern[/b][/h3]
You can now build large lanterns that will light up your village and caves.

[h3][b]All game code has been optimized[/b][/h3]
I had to optimize all the game code for better memory management. The game now runs very smoothly.

Please start a new game to avoid any compatibility issues.

Feel free to join the Official Game Discord to chat with the community, share your suggestions, and help us find bugs!

Don't forget to save your previous game before starting a new one!

In earlier versions, I introduced new biomes, creatures to tame, and various gameplay improvements that enhanced village management and exploration. Each update brought new challenges and exciting additions, and we’re thrilled to continue expanding the game with this new update!

Biomes are different types of zones or environments within the game, each with its own unique characteristics, resources, and creatures:
-Snowy Mountains: A cold biome with icy landscapes, home to creatures like Yeti and specific resources suited to this climate.
-Forests: Dense, wooded areas where you can find a variety of animals, natural resources, and lush vegetation.
-Plains: Open, grassy areas ideal for farming and exploration.

Each biome offers a unique experience with specific challenges to overcome.

Thanks for your support and enjoy the game :)

[i]Blackmyers[/i]
www.blackmyers.com

notes.title: New Content Added / Hero Creator Update 1.32
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here is the list of additions that I implemented in the Hero Creator 1.32 Experimental update.

[h3][b]Detail to access the Hero Creator update[/b][/h3]
Visit our website for details on how to download this update: [url=https://www.blackmyers.com/ExperimentalUpdate1.32][b]Website[/b][/url]

[h2][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Training Camp[/b][/h3]
Soldiers will now train when they have nothing to do.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/af037d481c385ada3593376dec23d36773a2a938.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Snow on Building[/b][/h3]
There is now snow on all buildings in the snowy mountain biome.

[h3][b]House Confort[/b][/h3]
Houses use wood for heating in winter.

[h3][b]Workbench Level 2[/b][/h3]
I added the workbench level 2 which will allow us to make more advanced things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/fd24885da52b1f56ab2babd45d67405175a39b6e.png[/img]

[h3][b]Wood Cabin[/b][/h3]
You can build a small wooden cabin that will allow you to warm up and protect you from bad weather.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/f5fe1ac0c913ec79f6537e1d12828b90e3b5805b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/8d54debe370da1313a210df193b3b9893ca54534.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New Pickaxe[/b][/h3]
You can now obtain the Steel Pickaxe recipe by defeating the Spider Boss and the Silver Pickaxe recipe by defeating the Elemental in the caves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/ab6691823ece5b677ab19cbb93434c666e10c981.png[/img]

[h3][b]Road System[/b][/h3]
You can build roads in your village that will allow you to have smoother traffic. You can choose the name of your roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/0543850e942b8fcfc3d41b9c3473715bf857c47e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Worker Salary[/b][/h3]
The worker is now demanding a salary from you that you must pay every day. His salary varies according to his knowledge.

[h3][b]Cave protection[/b][/h3]
You can ask your soldiers to clear the village caves from enemies.

[h3][b]Split item stack[/b][/h3]
Now you can divide the stack of objects by 2 by pressing Left Shift and the right mouse button.

[h3][b]Archer or Soldier ?[/b][/h3]
You can now choose a soldier or an archer. Soldiers will prioritize handed weapons and archers will prioritize long-range weapons.

[h3][b]Baby horse for sale[/b][/h3]
You can now buy baby horses at the general store.

[h2][b]ADJUSTMENT AND BUG FIX[/b][/h2]

I fixed the problem of the archer not shooting with the blunderbuss and the crossbow.
I fixed the problem of space detection in the inventory not taking into account unlocked slots.
I increased the stack of the standing torch to 10.
I adjusted the resources to craft equipment.
I adjusted the lighting of the standing torch.
I added light in the barn.
I adjusted the goblins' attacks.
I adjusted the brightness during night.
And other bugs have been fixed.

I will be working on the last part of this experimental update. I will come back to you in a few weeks with this update.

Thanks for your support and good game :)

[b]Blackmyers[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/83cfa6034d6d72fe1c82488bdc0fb5b32abf5dff.png[/img]

You can install a large furnace to melt your metals and craft ingots. Your miners will take your ingots to the General Store.

You can now enter into the General Store and make your purchases and sales at the counter with a new, more appropriate menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/8302d7e813cede77a7e3588ce2c6f0c76ec13a4f.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Caves[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/b6b35f28cc9f1fac10ac7c0aa47db584145e8712.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/830e16de2261c7c21f614b6832599c0d3b43d817.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/e2e7b96b5f99128822272973efcc2735d99e4230.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/ff6b2f8372b0f2ea2a7b82b913dd28cc252c9fbb.png[/img]

Werewolves appear during the night of a full moon. They are very dangerous but they can be very useful if you had a good relationship with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/1226dc34a5bc0ca33e6820c3ea239b3db910c2a6.png[/img]

You must eliminate all enemies in the cave so that your miners can enter and extract the resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/19892b142b1d72d67552df78b4708527956a4d90.png[/img]

[h2][b]Access blocked[/b][/h2]
Some accesses are blocked by doors with a lock that must be unlocked with a unique key that you must find. If this door is locked, the economic exchange will not be possible between the villages located in the winter and forest biomes.

You will be able to work in collaboration with the heroes of different villages to eliminate the cave trolls who will give you the key to open the door.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/34e7c307b796b0ff1de3d06238d770ad1133df83.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/3d897c823f012752c6ff9867e5b493ae3d69ed71.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]The Yetis villages[/b][/h2]
[i]*Work in progress*[/i]
Yetis build their village in the snowy mountains. They are neutral in nature but aggressive. If you mine their resources, they will become enemies with you and will attack your villages randomly but if you bring them food, they will become allies with you and you will have access to a horn that you can use to call them when your village is attacked and there will come to your nearest village and help you fight the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/9c7c0418f5059a5d0da2c9b0a4f00078340272ad.png[/img]

[h2][b]Cave Troll[/b][/h2]
[i]*Work in progress*[/i]
You will be able to fight the troll and choose to eliminate it or tame it and have the possibility of having it at your side. You will be able to mount it and destroy the enemy villages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/1fb39c28f1c41ccfd2565fc837fbd4e1ca4db9bd.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Road System[/b][/h2]
[i]*Work in progress*[/i]
You can build roads in your villages. Villagers prioritized roads to reach their destination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/4340459c44dcc7c2c20b5b4aa651490d2c8acbe2.png[/img]

[h2][b]Rabbit Trap[/b][/h2]
[i]*Work in progress*[/i]
You can make rabbit traps and place them in the woods so you can catch them.
Some rabbits can evolve into Buckdjeuve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/e13006056174ef654c8e666f3e72af5e63d8b955.png[/img]

[h2][b]Buckdjeuve[/b][/h2]
[i]*Work in progress*[/i]
The Buckdjeuve are very fast and dangerous. Their attack deals a lot of damage. You can capture them and mount them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/ce9eae6402c7c08b7763f2192914d86814d42e38.png[/img]

[h2][b]Saber-Tooth[/b][/h2]
[i]*Work in progress*[/i]
You can build a large cage for capture the Saber-Tooth. Once captured, it will follow you and you will be able to mount it to attack enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/6a8b6a33626490eed4251f0f02ad2cf1f82ecc38.png[/img]

I'm going to work on a level 2 workbench that will allow us to make more advanced things.

You will be able to build a large cage to capture the Buckdjeuve and the saber-tooth.

You will be able to build a small cabin that you can enter in and be able to warm up and cook meals.

You will be able to make specific equipment so you can attach to your mount, so you can ride on the trolls, Saber-tooth, caribou and the mammoth.

We will be able to buy a Research Table so that our blacksmiths can discover how to make new equipments.

I will finish the Store manager Task. They will be able to take care of selling the surplus of our goods to the neighbouring village and they will be able to buy things that you may need.

We can hire a soldier or a hero that we have created they will come the village manager and he have to take care of managing our village. They will take care of rebuilding the destroyed buildings, they will also take care of managing the workers jobs and they will protect the village.

I will go finalize this update and I invite you to test it and if you encounter bugs, do not hesitate to share it with us on Steam or on discord. [url=https://discord.com/invite/PW82dxkc7G]Discord Page[/url]

[b]*IMPORTANT*[/b]
- You need to start a new game with this update. The old save game is incompatible with this version. -

Thank you for your support and I wish you a great game :)

notes.title: Update 1.3 is now available
notes.content:
[h2]Update 1.3 is now available.[/h2]

[h3][b]New Game Modes[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]War Mode[/b][/h3]
In War mode you start directly to build your village on random land and you have to defend your village against Victor's attacks. The first who destroy the enemy village wins the game.

[h3][b]Survival Mode[/b][/h3]
In Survival mode, you start the game with nothing. You must start harvesting your resources to be able to craft your weapons and tools that will allow you to survive. Find work in neighboring villages to help you earn money and then buy your own land which will allow you to build your village.

[h3][b]New hero Victor Muller[/b][/h3]
Victor will build his village and you will be able to challenge him or help him progress

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/eb42506358a8177f37a74b59d46a13201dff66be.png[/img]

[h3][b]Reputations among heroes[/b][/h3]
The actions you take towards Victor will have a direct impact on your reputation. If you threaten or attack his village and the people who live there, your reputation will plummeted and you will become an enemy. Then Victor will attack you constantly to be able to invade your village.

And if you do tasks for Victor, your reputation will increase. And you can become an allied and trade together. 

[h3][b]Economic Exchange System[/b][/h3]
Sell your overstock goods to the allied village and you can also request missing food, resources and equipment for your village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/9a620f726f99de624e429565d0bdaf449a761e76.png[/img]

[h3][b]Stone Wall[/b][/h3]
Build stone walls to strengthen your defenses

[h3][b]Horse Stable[/b][/h3]
Hire a stable man to breed and maintain your horses. You have the option of buying young horses (foals) at a low price or more expensive adult horses. Attach a wagon to your horse to deliver goods to the Allied Village or to collect your resources. This will allow you to carry more resources. You can also ride the horse to travel the world of Zarabon faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/e9fb52d9c988bf6d06b7e74ca5ba7a25c453c4b4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/df0e1dac07c8c99568ef590f669f7d523316ee16.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/28df13e044781618507d61dffbd2a2bec5e51375.png[/img]

[h3][b]Water Well[/b][/h3]
Your stable men will collect water for your horses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/26df0b68ca17e5bf77e761c8ee1a7cba5cb27e9b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Climb in the towers[/b][/h3]
You can climb in the towers for better defend your village.

[h3][b]Extension of land[/b][/h3]
You can now purchase land extensions for your village. This will allow your workers to seek resources elsewhere for your village.

[h3][b]Adding resources to the map[/b][/h3]
I added small rocks of stone and iron, small bush and mushroom that you can pick up by hand.

[h3][b]Alek Crafting Menu[/b][/h3]
I created a crafting menu for Alek to craft basic things from his inventory.

[h3][b]New weapons and armor[/b][/h3]
Redwood Bow, Wooden Crossbow, Crusher Hammer et Victorious Armor

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/3f6e29a142a3dda4cd92365432293c221d1b3648.png[/img]

[h3][b]Shroombiters[/b][/h3]
This poisonous little mushroom, which passes unnoticed in the forest, will attack you when you pass near it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/f690dc6584594ab54a9e3bc78ff0e4c213c58c04.png[/img]

[h3][b]Captain Skeletor's treasure[/b][/h3]
Explore the world of Zarabon and find the treasure chests but be careful, this chest belongs to the pirate captain. Confront him to get the key to open the treasure chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/51f1a3939e1ed2eb698628b074bab16b6274a1d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/64b7ad7ce44c62ae73195dd9aae27076bc64fe7a.png[/img]

[h3][b]Moon of blood[/b][/h3]
When the blood moon appears during the night, the goblins go crazy. They will regroup to attack your village together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/8241c9dab7039e3c198bbd42c9bf7945c807e0c6.png[/img]

There will be random tasks that will be posted on the village board. You will be able to complete the tasks to make money and increase your reputation towards the village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39684518/9e25976ecdd32be651b47746a0eaaf301687271c.png[/img]

You can command your army to destroy enemy villages or protect allied villages.
